subject: Trial KPI & operational onboarding — Novio.ai
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@novio.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Quick recap + proposed success measures (post-demo)

Claire — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a first pass at POC success criteria so we can align the team and get procurement moving.

What we heard:
- Goal: Replace current API routing for content-classification and entity extraction use cases (batch + real-time) in production for internal search and triage.
- Current constraints: 100 reqs/s peak, median payload ~450 tokens, 95th percentile SLA expectation ~350ms.
- Success metric priority: accuracy (classification + entity F1), latency, and predictable per-token cost.

Proposed POC scope and acceptance gates (first pass):
1) Latency: p95 end-to-end (request in -> token out) < 350ms, p99 < 750ms for 1k QPS stress run (with 100 req/s steady-state target)
2) Throughput: sustain 100 rps steady-state with 50 concurrent connections; burst to 600 rps for short windows (auto-scaling exercise)
3) Cost: target cost <= $0.0008 per token served at observed token distribution (we'll supply sample token histogram)
4) Quality: classification accuracy >= 92% (macro-avg), entity extraction F1 >= 0.82; hallucination / false-positive rate < 1% on canonical eval set
5) Reliability: no more than 1% error rate (5xx/4xx) during test windows; graceful fallback path defined for capacity events

Owners we propose: Alex (AE) — overall coordination / trial checklist; Ben (CSM) — onboarding and evaluation cadence; Karthik (SRE) — infra/perf runs and load tests.

Next steps:
- I will share a short SOW + KPI workbook (attached) for you and procurement to review.
- Can you confirm a preferred 3-week window starting Oct 4 to run the trial, and who from your side will own acceptance (name + email)?
- Any additional data sensitivity / compliance needs we should include in the SOW?

Attachment: novio_poc-success-metrics.xlsx (POC KPI workbook)

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700

Alex — thanks for the summary and the proposed gates. This is helpful and aligned with our internal expectations. A few clarifications from our side:

- Acceptance owner: Michael Reyes (Head of ML Ops) will be the technical approver for quality and infra tests. He is cc'd.
- Timeline: Oct 4 start works but procurement will want a 4-week window (includes onboarding + smoke tests + two evaluation bursts). Can we do Oct 4 — Oct 29?
- Data: we'll provide a sampled dataset (PII redacted) and a token distribution file by Sep 22.
- Cost: vendor budget target is $0.00075/token but we are flexible if tradeoffs are realistic.

Please include a short line in the SOW about data handling and KMS integration (we use AWS KMS). Also flag any SOC2 evidence we can reference for procurement.

I'll review the workbook and get procurement looped for SOW review.

Thanks,
Claire
VP, Search & Data Products — Novio AI

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Claire's reply. Action items I want to capture before I send the SOW: 

- Karthik: can you confirm feasibility of the Oct 4 start and the target latency p95 <350ms with our default quantized model image? Also include any recommended instance profile to hit the cost envelope (we may need mixed q8 / q4 runs).
- Ben: drafting the SOW and want to add a short procurement checklist (SOC2 links + KMS integration steps). I'll drop a SOW draft and ask procurement to review.

Also thinking about a two-phase evaluation inside the 4-week window:
Phase A (week 1): onboarding, smoke tests, KV/prefix caching validation, small sample run (target steady-state 100 rps)
Phase B (weeks 2–4): two full evaluation bursts (48–72hr each) with alternating model configs to compare quality vs cost. We should log token-level cost and per-route latency in the dashboard.

If you can reply with estimated cost/token ranges and an infra profile by Monday (21 Sep) I'll incorporate into the SOW.

—Alex

Subject: Novio trial SOW + KPI workbook (next steps & timelines)

Claire / Michael — attaching the SOW draft and the KPI workbook per our discussion. Summary of the agreed plan below and explicit acceptance gates so procurement has what they need.

Schedule
- Onboarding window: Oct 4 — Oct 8 (smoke tests, KMS handoff, dataset ingestion)
- Evaluation window: Oct 11 — Oct 29 (two 72-hour bursts scheduled for Oct 12–15 and Oct 20–23; exact windows flexible)

Acceptance gates (final):
1) Latency: p95 < 350ms and p99 < 750ms measured on production-like traffic during each 72-hour burst. If p95 misses by <10% we allow one remediation run; a second miss triggers rollback to fallback model.
2) Throughput: sustain 100 rps steady with <2% error rate; must tolerate bursts up to 600 rps for up to 10 minutes with autoscale events observed and documented.
3) Cost: median per-token cost <= $0.00085 (we agreed to be flexible up to $0.0009 if quality delta justifies). Final cost reconciled after the trial with logs.
4) Quality: baseline eval on Novio canonical set — classification accuracy >= 92% and entity F1 >= 0.82; false-positive rate < 1%. Ben will own the final quality sign-off with Michael.
5) Compliance: KMS integration complete; SOC2 Evidence links shared in SOW (see attachment).

Deliverables and owners
- Redwood: SOW + KPI workbook (attached) — Alex (owner)
- Redwood: infra/perf run plan + instance profile recommendation — Karthik (owner)
- Novio: canonical eval set + token distribution + procurement sign-off — Michael (owner)
- Redwood + Novio: final sign-off call scheduled Oct 30 to review burst results and make decision on rollout.

Attachments: novio_poc-success-metrics.xlsx; novio_sow_draft.docx

Please confirm by EOD Sep 24 so we can lock the onboarding calendar and procurement paperwork.

Thanks — Alex
